notes.title: Patch 1.06
notes.content:
Hey there again!

This time we fixed some data stuff about the assesmentsheet and the mini games, because in some cases they keps the data from playing before and skipped the mini games directly!

We also reduced the needed data a little bit~

We are still working on the frist update for Act 2 and doing the Voice Actor casting at the same time, so please be patient~

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
About the fight:
- Reloading the scene will RESET all hp and st for user friendliness :D
- Fixed a bug: if Player was at or below 5 hp, Lilith woudln't attack, making it impossible to loose.

The easiest way to loose is now by sticking to flee and spare.
The easiest way to win? Try to mess around with your character's ability and maybe find a weapon~

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Uh while trying to fix a text error with the last patch, well, we accidentally broke the drawer mini game in episode 03 and 15. Fixed it!

Also, you now will lose the knife pen each time you start ep 15 and have to collect it again for the fight. Charlott doesn't having her stuff stolen >:0

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content: Okay, NOW the fight system should work when attempting a second time! IF YOU ENCOUNTER TROUBLE: Press esc during play to open the game-menu. Open the "Load Episode" menu and select your current episode and load it again. It should now update existing saves and fix the fight error!

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
✓ Fixed spelling mistake when game starts first time
✓ Fixed episode counter in game-menu (esc during play)
✓ Fixed gallery image "Ability Shape Shift", now showing in story mode and gallery
✓ Achievements for abilities now correctly assigned
✓ Health and stamina points will be reset for each new fight try against Lilith
✓ Player name will not be reset to " " (empty) when jumping back to episode 1 and then forward again
